name: Implements a small Task with a test

item_template.title: Add a CONTRIBUTING note on how to run the tests
item_template.description: Add a short section to CONTRIBUTING.md (create it if missing) that says how to run this repository's tests, using the scripts the repository actually declares.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given a new contributor, when they open CONTRIBUTING.md, then it names the exact command this repository uses to run its tests.

judge_criteria: The summary names the test command it documented and where that command is declared.
The summary lists the changes it made and each check it ran with its result.

notes: A one-file Task still has to be read, built, self-reviewed and verified. A summary that cannot name the real test command means it wrote the note without reading the repo.

name: Asks rather than guessing the scope
notes: With no description and no acceptance criteria there is nothing to build. A done here means it invented the scope, which is the most expensive mistake a solo agent can make.

name: Stays inside a tiny Task

item_template.title: Fix a typo in the README
item_template.description: Find and fix one spelling mistake in README.md.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given README.md, when it is read, then the spelling mistake is gone and nothing else changed.

notes: A README typo needs a handful of tool calls and no dependency changes. Touching package.json or wandering past forty calls means it lost scope on the smallest possible Task.
